messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Elevated 5xx rate observed on inference endpoints in us-east-1a (az1a). Started ~2026-03-15T10:08Z. Auto-retries triggered. Paging oncall team.

alex: oncall here — seeing a spike in 500 / connection reset errors from inference-api-route, and TLS handshake timeouts on some clients.

mira: checking networking metrics, VPC flow logs show increased retransmits and TCP resets to az1a worker subnets. ENI RX drops are high.

sam: net-bot — any upstream AWS alerts?

net-bot: AWS health: resolver throttling and NLB target health flaps reported in us-east-1a. Separate advisory: increased control-plane latency for some AZ-local operations.

jordana: Do Dedicated pools in az1a look affected or just hosted? Need to know customer scope.

alex: quick look — hosted API routes show ~18% errors at peak. 2 Dedicated customers with pinned capacity in az1a seeing elevated latency but fewer 5xx. Bulk of customer impact is hosted traffic.

kyle: plan: 1) steer new requests away from az1a via smart-routing 2) scale up cross-AZ capacity in us-east-1 3) reduce batch size on G5 pools to lower connection pressure. Applying routing policy now.

mira: applying routing change:
```bash
redwoodctl routing update --region us-east-1 --from-az az1a --policy prefer-other-az --drain 60s
```

alex: doing a targeted failover for inference-api-v2 -> moving warm pool to az1b, canary to az2a. Triggering additional KV-cache warmup to avoid cold-start latency.

sam: reducing batch size on inference workers:
```json
{"worker_pool":"g5-medium","batch_size":8}
```

net-bot: NLB target health checks recovering for a subset after the route update. Resolver throttle advisory persists (~10% of queries delayed).

jordana: customer impact assessment: 3 customers reported user-facing errors (elevated 500s), estimated request loss window ~10:08-10:22Z for majority. Internal telemetry shows errors dropped after routing change.

eng-oncall: current status — error rate reduced from 18% -> 3% across region. p95 latency still +120ms over baseline. Marking as Sev2 (partial degradation).

alex: notification to customers draft: "We experienced elevated errors in us-east-1a due to a zonal networking resolver & target health issue. Traffic was routed away from the affected AZ and degradation mitigated. We continue to monitor; root cause investigation underway." Thoughts?

mira: add note about possible AWS resolver throttle; ask infra for AWS support case and collect resolver logs.

sam: opened AWS case #CASE-20260315-001, included VPC and ENI metrics, NLB logs, and routing changes. AWS assigned a response team.

kyle: temporary mitigations we enacted (for postmortem):
- smart-router az-preference changed to prefer-other-az for 30m
- warmed KV cache in az1b/az2a
- decreased batch size on G5 pools
- increased short-term cross-AZ autoscale headroom +20%

alex: can we push a brief status page update? I'll post a short item on status.redwood.ai.

jordana: communications: send to affected customers with summary + ETA for RCA (48h). Ops to coordinate with AMs.

eng-oncall: handoff — I'm leaving at 10:40Z, handing to net team (sam/mira). If error rate creeps above 5% re-page.

mira: acknowledged, will own monitoring and AWS liaison.

sam: continuing to watch NLB health and resolver latencies. If AWS advises configuration change, we'll coordinate deploy.

alex: quick checklist for post-incident items:
- hypothesis: AZ-local DNS/resolver throttling causing TCP conn churn -> NLB target flaps -> inference 5xx (owner: net-team)
- collect full packet captures and NLB logs (owner: sam)
- run load test against fallback routing config to validate stability (owner: eng-reliability)
- update routing policy defaults if needed (owner: platform)
- customer comms and RCA writeup (owner: support + eng)

eng-oncall: closing note: system stabilized after routing change and scale ops. Keep monitoring for the next 3 hours, then revert routing policy if no regressions. Great job on quick mitigations everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated, current severity: S2, start: 2987654321, mitigated: 2987654500, assigned owners: net-team, eng-reliability, support."
